cohort: The study included 461 pregnant women who attended an antenatal booking clinic in Lagos, Nigeria, between 10 and 28 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: The study found a 29% prevalence of vitamin D deficiency but no significant differences between vitamin D groups regarding pregnancy complications, preeclampsia, or rate of caesarean section.
mod_finding: There were no differences between maternal vitamin D groups regarding the rate of caesarean section.
